n.description: The N of the answer's [SOURCE N] markers.
n.title: N

snippet.description: First 200 characters of the chunk. Untrusted document text.
snippet.title: Snippet

grounded.description: Whether all claims in the answer are supported by cited sources.
grounded.title: Grounded

unsupported_claims.description: Claims not backed by cites sources. Empty if grounded, or if tier = 'no_citations' (not evaluated).
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

reason.description: Short explaination of the verification verdict.
reason.title: Reason

tier.description: Which gate produced the verdict: 'no_citations', 'llm_judge', or 'verifier_error' (verifier provider failed; answer served unverified, not cached).
tier.title: Tier

sufficient.description: Whether retrieved context was judged sufficient to answer the query.
sufficient.title: Sufficient

reason.description: Short explanation of the sufficiency verdict.
reason.title: Reason

tier.description: Which gate produced the verdict: 'score_floor', 'llm_judge', or 'empty'.
tier.title: Tier

schema.description: The `final` event of POST /query/stream: every /query field plus the chunks behind the markers.

query_id.description: Unique identifier for this request. Use for tracing and debugging.
query_id.title: Query Id

rewritten_query.description: The query after LLM rewriting, as actually used for retrieval.
rewritten_query.title: Rewritten Query

answer.description: The grounded answer generated by the LLM.
answer.title: Answer

sources.description: Retrieved context chunks used to generate the answer.
sources.title: Sources

chunks_used.description: Number of chunks passed to the LLM.
chunks_used.title: Chunks Used

provider.description: The LLM provider that generated the answer.
provider.title: Provider

sufficiency.description: Context sufficiency gate result. None if the gate did not run.

citation_check.description: Citation Verification gate result. None if generation was skipped (e.g. abstain or insufficient context).

confidence.description: 'high' if citation verified, 'low' if not. None if generation was skipped.
confidence.title: Confidence

outcome.description: 'abstain' | 'answer_low_confidence' | 'answer' — derived from sufficiency/citation_check/confidence; 'cached' for a semantic-cache hit; 'empty' when retrieval found nothing.
outcome.title: Outcome

prompt_version.description: Hash of the pipeline prompts in config.py that produced the answer.
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

caveat.description: The low-confidence note, already appended to `answer`. None when confident or not answered.
caveat.title: Caveat

chunks.description: The chunks handed to generation, numbered as in [SOURCE N]. Empty when retrieval found nothing.
chunks.title: Chunks

schema.title: QueryStreamFinal
